title: Protocol for the separation of extracellular vesicles by ultracentrifugation from in vitro cell culture models
protocol: Subculture MCF10A cells.
Plate approximately 750,000 cells in a 100 × 20 mm TC-treated dish.

Maintain the cells in DMEM/F:12 media containing 5% EV-free horse serum, EGF at a final concentration of 20 ng/mL, hydrocortisone at 0.5 mg/mL, Cholera Toxin at 100 ng/mL, insulin at 10 ug/mL, and 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin.
Remove the media from cells when they reach 80-90% confluency.
Treat cells with 2.5 μM RSL3 for 18 hours in EV-free media.
Collect cell culture media and transfer into 50 mL conical tubes.
Keep samples on ice at all times to prevent EV degradation.
Pellet down cells by centrifuging 50 mL conical tubes in Centrifuge 5810 R at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the pellet and transfer the supernatant into new 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes in Centrifuge 5810 R at 3,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the pellet and transfer the supernatant into new 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes in Centrifuge 5810 R at 4,000 rpm for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant into ultracentrifuge tubes.
Be cautious when transferring supernatant in steps 6, 8, and 10.
Use a portable pipette controller until ~5 mL media remain in the centrifuge tube.
Collect remaining media using P200 and P1000 pipettes.
Place ultracentrifuge tubes into pre-cooled SW 32.1 Ti Swinging-Bucket rotor.
Centrifuge tubes in Optima XPN-80 Ultracentrifuge at 22,000 rpm for 140 min at 4°C.
Fill ultracentrifuge tubes to a sufficient volume.
Remove media and resuspend pellets in 10 mL cold PBS.
Do NOT use aspirator to remove media.
Gently pipette using P1000 pipette when ~1–2 mL media remain in the tube.
Use P200 pipette to remove residual media.
Centrifuge samples in Optima XPN-80 Ultracentrifuge at 22,000 rpm for 140 min at 4°C.
Carefully aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in suitable buffer for further downstream applications and characterization analyses, such as immunoblot, mass spectrometry, or TEM.
For immunoblot and TEM, resuspend the EV-containing pellet in 30 μL–50 μL of RIPA buffer and cold PBS, respectively.
Incubate the resuspended sample on ice for 10 minutes.
For ICP-mass spectrometry, resuspend the EV-containing pellet in 0.5 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge the sample in a SpeedVac vacuum concentrator at 45°C.
Digest the sample with 100 μL of HNO3 and heat it for 20 minutes at 65°C.
Dilute the heated sample to 2 mL with ddH2O before analysis.
Optional: Store EV-containing pellets at −80°C while maintaining EV membrane integrity and quality.
